messages:
Jo: Heads-up: we observed a transient RBAC failure during a private HSM switchover that impacted audit-forwarder ingestion for ~18m.
Ravi: Which cluster? any netpol churn?
Jo: us-east-2 private-vpc-2. infra-bot shows keystore.rotate start=2026-09-07T23:04Z end=23:06Z; forwarder restarted at 23:05Z.
Ana: Forwarder SA is svc-audit-ingest. Does it rely on IRSA token refresh?
Tasha: Yes. During keystore swap the keystore controller also rotates envelope keys and triggers IAM token refresh in the shim. If the forwarder pod restarts during token swap it can get a stale token and 403.
Ravi: Immediate fix: add a post-start hook to the forwarder container that validates current keystore envelope key access and retries before accepting traffic.
Jo: Also suggest enabling PVC-backed queue for private deployments; default ephemeral queues are risky with restarts.
sec-oncall: Incident INC-2026-2334 opened. Triage: @Jo, @Tasha.
Tasha: I'll prototype a small pre-failover webhook on keystore controller to request forwarder quiesce-checkpoint.
Ana: Audit task: list roleBinding changes 30m around the rotation and snapshot forwarder logs.
Jo: I'll add these to the runbook and schedule a tabletop exercise for HSM failover scenarios.
Ravi: Also add a networkpolicy rule to allow egress to splunk endpoint by hostname/ip to avoid node-level blackholes during node shuffles.
